show: Life Will Be the Death of Me with Chelsea Handler

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Kristen Johnston joins to talk about sobriety, aging, and life after 40.
kurzfassung: Chelsea Handler and guest Kristen Johnston discuss aging, sobriety, and coping with life's changes. They share personal stories about handling grief, hobbies, and the challenges of being a woman in the public eye. The episode concludes with listener advice on relationships, family addiction, and lifestyle changes.
stichpunkte: Kristen Johnston talks about her role in Sex and the City and her journey to long-term sobriety.
The hosts discuss the general malaise in Los Angeles and their love for New York City.
A deep conversation explores the realities of aging, including facial hair maintenance and hobbies.
Advice is given to a listener struggling with intense grief and the loss of a father.
Another listener seeks guidance on how to approach a brother showing signs of high-functioning addiction.
The episode wraps up with a lighthearted question about navigating flatulence in a new relationship.

kapitel.titel: Tour Dates and Welcome Kristen Johnston
Bird Watching, Velcro, and Sex and the City
Sobriety, Hobbies, and New York vs. Los Angeles
Aging Realities and Dealing with Grief
Advice for a Content Single Man
A Lighthearted Question on Relationship Etiquette

clips.hook: Bird watching as a slippery slope
clips.text: Chelsea Handler shares that one of her close friends has just dropped off their child at university.

clips.hook: Twenty years of sobriety and counting
clips.text: Kristen Johnston discusses the shared late-night shifts and high-energy lifestyle connecting actors, theater workers, and restaurant staff.
The host introduces Solita, a podcast focused on personal transformation and solo travel.

clips.hook: Bragging about a great single life
clips.text: Chelsea Handler and her guest discuss Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and recent news stories involving real estate purchases.

clips.hook: Fighting like a tiger to protect an addiction
clips.text: The conversation shifts to personal reflections and shared experiences from their past.

beschreibung:
Kristen Johnston is here to chat with Chelsea about her occasional foray into cocaine before she got sober, her new role on Leann (on Netflix), and why fame initially terrified her. Then: A sister worries that her brother’s drinking has gotten out of control. A new girlfriend finds that beans and boyfriends don’t mix. And a daughter grieves the father she cared for, whose personality changed at the end of his life.
